description: Drupal module class defining a custom field formatter for video files, including settings for muted, inline play, width, and height.

classes.name: FileVideoFormatter
classes.description: A Drupal field formatter plugin for displaying video files with customizable settings.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Provides default settings for the formatter, including muted, playsinline, width, and height.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Builds the settings form for the formatter, allowing configuration of muted, playsinline, width, and height.

methods.name: settingsSummary
methods.description: Generates a summary of current settings for display.

methods.name: prepareAttributes
methods.description: Prepares HTML attributes for the video element based on settings.
